incidents.title: Pre-deployment: settlement-breaking outage could go unnoticed
incidents.summary: Before external monitoring existed, a facilitator could report liveness green while settlement was broken, and no one would know until a dependent checked production. This is the exact failure mode that cost the org 207 permanently lost ledgers in a prior silent indexer outage. Issue #19 closes the gap: external probes (including a synthetic testnet payment), a named on-call owner with escalation, degraded-mode contracts, and this incident history. Recorded honestly as the first entry so the page shows a real, credible history rather than a perpetually green 'no incidents ever'.
